settings.title: Application Settings
settings.costs_desc: Override the default pricing used for cost calculations. Leave blank to use defaults.
settings.strategy_standard_help: Fast & Efficient. Best for standard typed text documents and clear emails.
settings.strategy_reasoning_help: Deep Analysis. Uses Chain-of-Thought to justify decisions before classifying. Useful for ambiguous cases.
settings.strategy_vision_help: Multimodal. Analyzes visual elements (images, layouts) in addition to text. Best for documents with photos or complex structures.

exports.title: Data Exports & Fine-Tuning
exports.desc: Export your processed data for reporting or for training better AI models.
exports.csv_desc: Download a complete list of all processed emails with their status, costs, and metadata.
exports.csv_streaming: Streaming Support: This export generates data on-the-fly, allowing downloads of very large datasets (10k+ rows) without server timeout or crashes.
exports.csv_columns: Includes: ID, Status, Detected Intents, Confidence Scores, AI Usage Costs (USD), and Processing Time.
exports.jsonl_desc: Export a 'Reinforcement Learning' dataset designed for Azure OpenAI / Phi-4 fine-tuning.
exports.jsonl_format: Format: JSON Lines (JSONL), compatible with Azure AI Foundry.

usage.title: How to Use
usage.step1_desc: The main dashboard provides a real-time view of incoming emails.
usage.step1_li1: Status Codes: Green (Processed), Amber (Review Required), Red (Error).
usage.step1_li2: Scoring: Confidence scores (0-100%) indicate how certain the AI is.
usage.step1_li3: Indicators: Look for badges indicating Sensitive Data or Images.
usage.step2_desc: Click 'Open Details' on any email to enter the review mode.
usage.step2_li1: View the original PDF and the extracted Markdown side-by-side.
usage.step2_li2: See the AI Analysis section for reasoning.
usage.step2_li3: Correct categories if the AI is wrong. Provide a reason to help future Fine-Tuning.
usage.step3_desc: Use the Upload tab to manually ingest PDF files for testing. In production, files arrive automatically via Email/Blob Storage.
usage.step4_desc: Customize the behavior of the engine in the Settings tab.
usage.step4_li1: Categories: Define exact intent names. Changes apply immediately.
usage.step4_li2: Processing Strategy: Switch between Standard, Reasoning, or Vision modes.

filters.title: Filtering & Stats
filters.desc: The dashboard offers advanced filtering capabilities to help you prioritize your work and analyze performance.
filters.category_desc: Isolate emails by specific intent (e.g., 'Address Change'). Useful for targeted reviews or validating a specific intent type.
filters.confidence_desc: Focus on low-confidence items (< 50%) to fix errors, or high-confidence items to spot-check the AI's performance.
filters.quality_desc: The global 'Avg. Quality' card tracks the mean confidence score across all processed emails, providing a global view of model performance.

ai.title: Global Complexity & Reasoning
ai.desc: The system determines complexity based on:
ai.li1: Multi-Intent: Emails requesting multiple distinct actions (e.g., 'Change address AND send statement').
ai.li2: Ambiguity: Vague wording requiring inference or context from attachments.
ai.li3: Strategy: Using the 'Reasoning' strategy (Settings) forces the AI to output a justification before classifying, improving accuracy on complex cases.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Safety (PII)
privacy.li1: Detection: The AI flags emails containing sensitive data (Social Security Numbers, Finance details, Health info).
privacy.li2: Anonymization: When exporting data for fine-tuning, the system automatically scrubs names, emails, and dates using a dedicated anonymizer model.

vision.title: Smart Vision & Annotation (Mistral Document AI)
vision.desc: The system now uses Mistral's BBox Annotation capability (via Schema) to extract structured insights from visual elements.
vision.standard_desc: When 'Vision' strategy is active, the system generates structured descriptions (Summary, Business Details) for every visual element (charts, photos) found in the PDF. This context is fed to the Classifier.
vision.vision_desc: Using a strict JSON Schema, the Vision model categorizes images and decides if they are 'relevant' to the business process, ignoring decorative elements.
